title: Prediction-Informed Landing Window Planning for UAV Landing on USV in High Sea States
abstract: arXiv:2610.13190v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous landing of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) on unmanned surface vehicle (USV) is difficult in high sea states. Existing hierarchical landing methods often infer future USV motion only implicitly from short observation histories, which limits their ability to adapt to severe and rapidly changing sea conditions. This paper presents a prediction-informed hierarchical control framework. A pretrained model is developed to explicitly predict the USV attitude during high-level landing decisions. The prediction helps identify suitable landing windows and choose the right touchdown time, while a conventional low-level flight controller maintains UAV stability and tracks motion commands. To evaluate the framework under realistic disturbances, a real-sim validation setup is constructed in which USV-motion data collected in real sea conditions are transferred to a MuJoCo USV. tldr: 本文提出一种预测信息驱动的分层控制框架，利用预训练模型显式预测无人艇姿态，从而识别着陆窗口并确定最佳触舰时机，实现高海况下无人机在无人艇上的自主着陆。
